hypotheses.text: If Emil Strand had shot instead, the chance to score would have been lower than the 6.5% produced after the pass.
If Emil Strand had carried the ball forward instead of passing, the resulting chance to score would have been lower than the 6.5% after the pass.
If Emil Strand had passed to Sami Okoro (CM) instead, the chance to score would have been lower than the 6.5% produced by the pass to Leo Marchetti.
